deactivateConfirm.title: Deactivate proctor
deactivateConfirm.description: The proctor will no longer be able to sign in or be assigned to future exams. Existing data is retained for the audit log.

closeConfirm.title: Close period
closeConfirm.description: Once closed, no further exams can be added and proctors can no longer update their availability.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete exam
deleteConfirm.description: Exams can only be deleted from an open period that has no proctor responses yet.

runConfirm.title: Run scheduler
runConfirm.description: This regenerates the schedule for the period and overwrites any existing assignments. You can still adjust individual classrooms manually afterwards.

send.title: Send the schedule
send.description: Choose which proctors will receive the schedule by email. By default everyone is selected.
send.noRecipients: No proctors are assigned to this period.

proctor.periodLocked: This period is no longer accepting availability changes.

selectedDates.title: My selected dates
selectedDates.empty: You have not marked availability for any exams in this period.

submit.thanks: Thanks — please wait for the exam department to publish the schedule.
submit.lockedError: The period is closed — submission is no longer possible.

confirm.title: Submit availability
confirm.description: Once submitted you can no longer change your availability for this period. Continue?

mySchedule.empty: No assignments yet. You'll be notified once the exam department publishes the schedule.
